payload.subject_id: existing local balance row, canonical kebab-case identifier
payload.delta: nonzero integer with absolute value <= 1000000; bool/float rejected

result_interface: apply_or_recognize returns {evidence, replayed}; recognize returns the same recorded evidence or None for observed absence. LedgerFailure exposes code/classification.
